# Parameter counts (generated by `python -m tools.count_params`)

Each model is built from its training YAML as its trainer builds it, with a random CLIP ViT-L/14 vision tower (architecture only, no checkpoint). `State keys` must equal the denominator of the 'Weight loading report' that `smsdt.eval_cross` prints for that run (393 GenD, 415 S, 471 ST, 489 Full in the eval logs).

| Model | Config | Trainable | LayerNorm (backbone) | Head and other | Total | Trainable % | State keys |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `gend_ours` | `configs/train_gend.yaml` | 103,425 | 102,400 | 1,025 | 303,180,801 | 0.034% | 393 |
| `smsdt_s` | `configs/train_s.yaml` | 777,478 | 102,400 | 675,078 | 303,854,854 | 0.256% | 415 |
| `smsdt_st` | `configs/train_st.yaml` | 8,467,462 | 102,400 | 8,365,062 | 311,544,838 | 2.718% | 471 |
| `smsdt_full` | `configs/train_full.yaml` | 9,102,600 | 102,400 | 9,000,200 | 312,179,976 | 2.916% | 489 |

CLIP ViT-L/14 vision tower: 303,179,776 parameters, of which 102,400 are LayerNorm weights and biases.
